title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode8 Our Film

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: The day of the Kamiyama High School Arts Festival

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Also, I can't wait to see what the other classes are gonna do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we get to vote on which did the best, right? How awesome would it be to win first prize?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
F-First might be kinda tough...
I heard the other classes also put a lot of effort into their things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your class is performing a dance routine, right? Don't you guys need to change? Do you still have time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
When we drew straws to see who's gonna go first, our class ended up somewhere towards the end!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your class made a film, right?
How'd it turn out...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just fine. Shooting it wasn't easy, but all that's left for us is to have everyone watch it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I dunno if I'm gonna be nervous or excited when it plays.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean the shoot went well...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It did. And the books you found for me really helped a lot, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry I couldn't thank you sooner.
But I really appreciate what you did for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Li'l Bro, you're the star, right? I can't wait to see how you did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just sit and watch quietly for me, will you?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The opening ceremony for the first annual Kamiyama High School Arts Festival will now begin. We ask that you all please take your seats.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's starting!
Let's go rejoin our class!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
See you later, guys!
It's the first ever arts festival, so let's make it a fun one♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It doesn't screen for a while, but my heart's already pounding... I'm not sure it's gonna make it through the whole thing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was a great play!
Kamishiro's class did such a good job!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But it sorta didn't make any sense...
What happened to paying homage to “The Phantom Of The Opera”...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wouldn't have guessed there'd be a passage to another world hidden underground, or that they'd fight a dragon there... It is something they'd come up with, though.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They did put on a really good performance, but I couldn't focus on it towards the end...)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
That concludes Class 3-C's play.
Next, we have a film by Class 2-A.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Our screening of “The Wandering Cook: A Post-Apocalyptic Tale of Gourmet Martial Arts” will now begin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah... I'm so nervous...
My face is gonna be on that screen.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's way too late to be saying anything like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Look who's talking. You seem pretty tense.
I bet you're just as nervous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really got to see a new side of everyone through this festival...)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Far in the future...
A series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, An and Li'l Bro are both doing a pretty good job!

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line:
“I'm a cook...
My purpose in life is to make the best food I can for those who need it...”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I don't care how hard it's going to be for me to do that. I'm not giving up...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well now... Those are some very convincing stunts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They must've practiced quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “No, Mr. Cook, where are you going...?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Please stay...!
I want you to stay in this village forever and ever!”

rows.Speaker: Former Dark Cook A
rows.Line: “Yeah, boss! You even helped us change our ways! After we attacked you, we became so hungry that we couldn't move... But then you made food for us...”

rows.Speaker: Former Dark Cook B
rows.Line: “You also reminded us of the importance of wanting to serve people the best food possible regardless of who comes asking...!”

rows.Speaker: Former Dark Cook C
rows.Line: “Yeah! So, please stay in this village and teach us your ways!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Yeah, we know...
You have to keep helping everyone that's in need of your cooking.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “If we ever need your cooking again, you have to come back and make food for us, okay...?”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And so, the Wandering Cook resumed his journey to help those in need of good food.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “He would venture back into the wastes, but a figure kept watching over him. The girl as she awaited his return.”

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: That concludes all the presentations for the first annual Kamiyama High School Arts Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Every class did such an amazing job!
I really loved the dance routine Mizuki's class did!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aoyagi looked like he had fun dancing too.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: But everyone cheered like crazy when they saw our film. That means we did a pretty good job too, right?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Do you think we have a shot at winning?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. I dunno about that.
I mean, Kusanagi said it's gonna be hard for us to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We might actually have a shot...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, I was worried sick this whole time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought we did a good job since we worked really hard on it, but I still wasn't sure how others would react to it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I could see that everyone was enjoying it once they started watching it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Including me.
Once it started playing on the big screen...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I found myself also having fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When everyone first asked me to direct our film, I wasn't at all sure how I'd do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm really shy...
I also felt this wall between me and all of you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But I got to know all of you as we worked on our film and became more comfortable as time went on.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm really glad we did this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep!
Wh-Why are you shaking my hand...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
What you just said makes me feel so happy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, thank you!
Making that film with you was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, I also had a lot of fun!
We should go fly drones together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: And you promised to go clothes shopping with me, remember?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
You gotta stop by my dojo sometime!
I wanna introduce our film's director to all the kids!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Thank you all for being so patient.
We have our tallies.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hope we do well since we worked so hard on our film...!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
We'll get started right away by announcing our third-place winner.
Class 2-B.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: With their interpretive dance titled “Alligator: Where Will The Waters Take Us?”

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Please send a representative up to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It was really tough conceptually, but I'm glad we worked so hard on the costumes for it!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Next, in second place comes...
Class 1-A with their orchestral rendition of “A Sonata For You”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that class with the orchestra...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They even roped in the music teacher. It's hard to believe some were playing their instruments for the first time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, they definitely deserve a spot on the podium...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe we never really had a shot. But...)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Now, in first place.
The winner of the first annual Kamiyama High School Arts Festival is...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Class 3-C!
With their play titled “The Phantom Of The Opera And The Tunnel To Another World”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really did. Thank you, Tsukasa, everyone... Our hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I really thought we had a chance too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But not placing isn't the end of the world.
To me, what we made means...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, we have a special prize from our judge.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, our teacher did mention something about inviting a special guest to serve as the judge...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: We've specially invited screenwriter Mr. Heizaburo Taniyama to serve as our judge today. And his decision is in.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Our special prize goes to... Class 2-A!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: To be honest, as a screenwriter, I wasn't sure how this class was going to keep the story in this film together. I was on the edge of my seat the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: However, they ended up doing a wonderful job. And in every frame, I could tell that they really worked as a team to make this film happen.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: I believe the tale of the Wandering Cook was an extraordinary expression of your youth... And I hereby award you with this prize. Congratulations.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We did it, Kusanagi!
We won the judge's prize!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Will the representative for Class 2-A please come join us on the stage to accept this trophy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's like I'm carrying everyone with me...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Over here, Director! We wanna take some pictures!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm a bit different from them, and they're still really prone to getting excited over the littlest things...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad I agreed to become the director...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope we get to have more fun and keep doing stuff like this together.)
